entities.name: Frigg
entities.effect: Scry 4, then draw 2. Prevent all damage to a target this turn.
entities.lore: Queen of Asgard, weaver of destiny's quiet threads.

entities.name: Baldr
entities.effect: Exile target attacking creature. At end of turn, its controller creates a 2/2 Token. Draw a card.
entities.lore: Beloved god of light whose death shakes worlds.

entities.name: Tyr
entities.effect: Target creature you control fights target creature you don't control. Your creature gains Vigilance.
entities.lore: One-handed champion who binds the wolf.

entities.name: Heimdall
entities.effect: Look at each opponent's hand. Creatures you control gain Ward 2 until your next turn.
entities.lore: Guardian of Bifröst with hearing beyond time.

entities.name: Frigg
entities.effect: Scry 4, then draw 2. Prevent all damage to a target this turn.
entities.lore: Queen of Asgard, weaver of destiny's quiet threads.

entities.name: Freyr
entities.effect: Put two +1/+1 counters on each of up to two creatures. Create two Food tokens.
entities.lore: Lord of harvest, bearer of peace and plenty.

entities.name: Freyja
entities.effect: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap it; it gains Flying and Haste. Scry 2, draw 1.
entities.lore: Vanir goddess of desire and witchcraft.

entities.name: Njord
entities.effect: Return target permanent to its owner's hand. Create two Treasure tokens.
entities.lore: Lord of ships and shining coasts.

entities.name: Idunn
entities.effect: Restore all damage to a creature; put two +1/+1 counters on it. Draw a card.
entities.lore: Keeper of apples that renew the gods.

entities.name: Sif
entities.effect: Create a Food token for each creature you control with power 2 or less. Gain 3 life.
entities.lore: Golden-haired wife of Thor, gentle strength of hearth.

entities.name: Skadi
entities.effect: Tap up to two target creatures. They don't untap during their controller's next untap step. Draw a card.
entities.lore: Giantess of skis and cold mountains.

entities.name: Bragi
entities.effect: Copy target instant or sorcery you control. You may choose new targets. Draw a card.
entities.lore: Silver-tongued bard of Asgard.

entities.name: Ullr
entities.effect: Target creature gains +2/+0 and can't be blocked this turn. Scry 2.
entities.lore: Swift hunter on skis with unerring aim.

entities.name: Forseti
entities.effect: Each player may draw a card; then choose and discard a card. Exile target tapped permanent.
entities.lore: Arbiter whose halls resolve all disputes.

entities.name: Hodr
entities.effect: Deal 2 damage to any target; if Baldr is on the field, exile that target instead.
entities.lore: Blind god whose shot felled the light.

entities.name: Vidar
entities.effect: Target creature gains +4/+4 and Indestructible until end of turn. It must be blocked if able.
entities.lore: Silent avenger who sunders jaws of doom.

entities.name: Vali
entities.effect: Create a 3/3 Aesir token with Haste and "When this dies, draw a card".
entities.lore: Born for vengeance in a single day.

entities.name: Hel
entities.effect: Each opponent exiles a card from their graveyard. Return a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
entities.lore: Queen of the dead beneath the roots of Yggdrasil.

entities.name: Fenrir
entities.effect: Destroy target creature. Create a 4/4 Wolf token with Trample.
entities.lore: World-wolf whose jaws bite worlds.

entities.name: Jormungandr
entities.effect: All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn. Create a 5/5 Serpent token.
entities.lore: Midgard serpent encircling the world.

entities.name: Surtr
entities.effect: Destroy all nonland permanents. Create a 6/6 Fire Giant token with Haste.
entities.lore: Flame-giant whose sword lights the end.

entities.name: Mimir
entities.effect: Draw 3 cards. Return up to two cards from your graveyard to your hand.
entities.lore: Head of wisdom kept by the well of knowledge.

entities.name: Aegir
entities.effect: Each player creates a Food token. Return up to two nonland permanents to their owners' hands.
entities.lore: Ocean-host whose halls roar with mead.

entities.name: Ran
entities.effect: Tap target creature and another target permanent. They don't untap during their controller's next untap step.
entities.lore: Net-weaver who drags ships beneath the waves.

entities.name: Norns (Urd, Verdandi, Skuld)
entities.effect: Reorder the top 7 cards of your library; you may exile any number of them. Draw 2 cards.
entities.lore: The three who measure what was, is, and will be.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.effect: Return up to two target creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield with +1/+1 counters. They gain Flying until end of turn.
entities.lore: Winged maidens bearing heroes to Valhalla.
